items.title: Crypto's Long-Sought 'De Minimis' Tax Break Gets a House Markup This Week
items.summary: The proposal would overhaul federal tax treatment of digital assets but still requires approval from Congress.

items.title: Crypto Clarity Act barrels toward disappointment barring last-minute Senate turnaround
Bitcoin Sinks as the Senate's Clarity Act Showdown Looms
items.summary: Bitcoin just gave back its entire post-golden-cross rally in one red candle, with a make-or-break Senate vote landing this afternoon and the Fed staring down a rate hike.
